name: Orthosiphon stamineus extract
description: Orthosiphon stamineus extract (CAS 84012-29-3 ), derived from the Java tea plant, is a standardized botanical extract used across food, pharmaceutical, and cosmetic formulations. Commercially recognized as cat's whiskers extract, it is sourced for its antioxidant activity. In food and nutraceutical products, it is incorporated into dietary supplements and functional beverages targeting antioxidant and general wellness positioning. Pharmaceutical formulators use it as an active botanical ingredient in herbal preparations. This extract is particularly valuable in markets where Java tea has established regulatory recognition. In personal care, it is formulated into skin-care products where antioxidant-active botanical extracts are required to support anti-aging or protective claims. As a flavoring and acidulant component, it contributes to the organoleptic profile of herbal teas and functional drink blends. The extract is supplied as a dry powder or liquid extract, with dry forms being the most common for supplement applications. Standard grades include food-grade and cosmetic-grade specifications, with standardization typically referenced against rosmarinic acid or sinensetin content. This ensures consistency across various industrial and manufacturing batches. The material is produced to meet rigorous quality benchmarks, including FCC and USP standards where applicable for dietary ingredients. These certifications ensure the extract meets the safety requirements for global distribution. Manufacturers often require documentation confirming compliance with Ph.Eur. or BP monographs for pharmaceutical-grade herbal substances.
